# foreman_katello_product (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_katello_product" "debian_12" {
  name = "Debian 12"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the katello_product to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `gpg_key_id` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `label` (String)
- `ssl_ca_cert_id` (Number)
- `ssl_client_cert_id` (Number)
- `ssl_client_key_id` (Number)
- `sync_plan_id` (Number)
